build_interwild_model: build a python module to create an InterWild hand pose estimation model using get_model with train or test mode
run_model_forward: run the Model forward pass with inputs, targets, meta_info, and mode to get hand pose predictions or losses
review_model_get_coord: review the Model get_coord method that computes 2D projected and 3D camera-centered joint coordinates from MANO parameters
test_init_weights: test the init_weights function that initializes Conv2d, ConvTranspose2d, BatchNorm2d, and Linear layer weights
refactor_model_forward: refactor the Model forward method to modify the hand bounding box detection or MANO pose estimation pipeline
